examples.arabic: قال خالد اسمي خالد واين الطريق الى الفندق من فضلك
examples.english: Khalid said my name is Khalid and where is the way to the hotel please.
examples.transliteration: qala khalid ismi khalid wa ayna at tariq ila al funduq min fadlik

examples.arabic: وعندما وصلت الى الفندق عرفت انه المهندس الذي يخطط لمشروع ضخم في المدينة
examples.english: And when I arrived at the hotel, I realized he was the engineer who was planning a huge project in the city.
examples.transliteration: Wa 'indamaa wasaltu ila al-funduqi 'araftu annahu al-muhandisu alladhee yukhaṭṭiṭu li-mashroo'in ḍakhmin fi al-madeenah.

examples.arabic: بدأنا نبحث عن رحلة مناسبة على الانترنت لكن كل فندق كان مكلفا للغاية
examples.english: We started looking for a suitable trip online, but every hotel was extremely expensive.
examples.transliteration: badaʾnā nabḥathu ʿan riḥlatin munāsibatin ʿalā al-intirnit, lākin kullu funduqin kāna mukallifan lilghāyati.
